title: ArcBio Continuous RNA Workflow - Post-PCR Instrument Purification
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Initialize workflow
steps.instruction: Prepare the OT‑2 for the 9‑part ArcBio Continuous RNA Workflow (Part 6 of 9) to process up to 96 input RNA samples into cDNA libraries as outlined in the attached experimental protocol.

steps.title: Mix enzyme mixture
steps.instruction: Mix the post‑indexing cleanup enzyme mixture with the samples while the plate is held at 4 °C on the OT‑2 Temperature Module.

steps.title: Transfer to thermocycler
steps.instruction: Remove the plate from the deck and place it in the off‑deck thermocycler to continue the post‑indexing purification steps as described in the attached protocol.
